Suspend somebody to refuse them access while keeping them and everything they have done, or reactivate them to let them back in. 🔴 THIS IS THE REVERSIBLE ONE — prefer it to remove_member whenever the person might come back, or while something is being looked into.

tools.name: remove_member

tools.name: list_invitations
tools.description:
Every invitation — pending, accepted and revoked — newest first.

tools.name: invite_person
tools.description: 🔴 USE THIS TO ADD A PERSON TO AN ORGANISATION. tools.name: revoke_invitation
tools.description:
Kills the invitation and its link immediately. This is what to use when an invitation went to the wrong address.

⚠️ Only a PENDING invitation can be revoked. One already accepted is a membership now — use remove_member instead.

tools.name: revoke_credential

tools.name: get_module_settings

tools.name: set_module_settings
tools.description:
Change what the platform does on this organisation’s behalf. Pass only the settings you are changing — anything you leave out is untouched, so you never need to read-then-write-everything, and two editors cannot overwrite each other.

tools.name: get_map_quickstart
tools.description: Everything needed to show a Mesh map in a web application: the package to install, a complete working example, the themes available, and what the control deliberately will not do. 🔴 Call this BEFORE writing any map code. The alternative — wiring MapLibre against the tiles API by hand — means redisc

tools.name: list_map_keys
tools.description: The map keys this organisation has, for drawing Mesh basemaps in a browser.

tools.name: create_map_key
tools.description: Create a key for drawing Mesh basemaps in a browser. ⚠️ A map key is NOT a secret — it is pasted into page source and anyone viewing the page can read it. tools.name: update_map_key
tools.description: Amend an existing map key in place: which websites it works from, and which regions it may read. 🔴 THE KEY VALUE IS UNCHANGED, so nothing already shipping it has to be updated — this is what to use when an application moves from a development server to a real domain, or gains a preview-deploy host.

tools.name: revoke_map_key
tools.description: Revoke a map key. Pages using it stop rendering maps immediately. ⚠️ Irreversible — if the goal is only to change which websites it works from, use update_map_key, which leaves the key value working.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description:
Subscribe a URL to Mesh events. Mesh signs each delivery with HMAC-SHA256 and retries failures. The signing secret is returned ONCE and cannot be retrieved again — store it with the application that will verify deliveries.

⚠️ NAME THE EVENT TYPES YOU INTEND TO HANDLE. A subscription with no filter

tools.description:
Change where a subscription posts, which events it receives, or whether it is active. Pass only what you are changing — anything you leave out is untouched, and the signing secret is never affected.

🔴 `eventTypes` REPLACES THE WHOLE FILTER, it does not add to it. Send the complete list the subscri

tools.name: rotate_webhook_secret
tools.description:
Issue a fresh HMAC signing secret for a subscription. The new secret is returned ONCE — write it into the application that verifies deliveries before you finish.

🔴 THE OLD SECRET STOPS WORKING IMMEDIATELY. Every delivery after this call is signed with the new one, so an application still holding t

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Stop delivering events to this subscription and remove it. ⚠️ Irreversible — to pause deliveries reversibly, call update_webhook with `active` set to false instead.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_connection_details, list_services, create_sign_in_app, invite_person, list_webhooks, get_webhook, create_webhook, update_webhook · Private data: list_orgs, create_org, get_connection_details, list_services, list_api_operations, get_openapi_spec, list_permissions, list_credentials, create_credential, create_sign_in_app, list_sign_in_apps, get_sign_in_app, update_sign_in_app, set_sign_in_branding, set_sign_in_logo, delete_sign_in_app, set_member_status, remove_member, list_invitations, invite_person, update_credential_permissions, revoke_credential, list_modules, set_module_settings, get_map_quickstart, create_map_key, update_map_key, get_webhook, create_webhook, update_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret · Public sink: get_connection_details, create_credential, create_sign_in_app, update_sign_in_app, set_sign_in_logo, invite_person, update_credential_permissions, update_map_key, list_webhooks, get_webhook, create_webhook, update_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret, delete_webhook · Destructive: update_sign_in_app, set_sign_in_branding, set_sign_in_logo, reset_sign_in_branding, delete_sign_in_app, remove_member, update_credential_permissions, list_modules, set_module_settings, delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_connection_details, list_services, create_sign_in_app, invite_person, list_webhooks, get_webhook, create_webhook, update_webhook · Private data: list_orgs, create_org, get_connection_details, list_services, list_api_operations, get_openapi_spec, list_permissions, list_credentials, create_credential, create_sign_in_app, list_sign_in_apps, get_sign_in_app, update_sign_in_app, set_sign_in_branding, set_sign_in_logo, delete_sign_in_app, set_member_status, remove_member, list_invitations, invite_person, update_credential_permissions, revoke_credential, list_modules, set_module_settings, get_map_quickstart, create_map_key, update_map_key, get_webhook, create_webhook, update_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret · Public sink: get_connection_details, create_credential, create_sign_in_app, update_sign_in_app, set_sign_in_logo, invite_person, update_credential_permissions, update_map_key, list_webhooks, get_webhook, create_webhook, update_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret, delete_webhook · Destructive: update_sign_in_app, set_sign_in_branding, set_sign_in_logo, reset_sign_in_branding, delete_sign_in_app, remove_member, update_credential_permissions, list_modules, set_module_settings, delete_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
